items.snippet: `Application.add_domain()` compiled each `*` in a host mask to `[^:]*`. With two or more wildcards in a mask, matching a long `Host` header that does not match the mask took polynomial time on the event loop. items.title: AIOHTTP: Unbounded cookie storage in client CookieJar
items.snippet: `Set-Cookie` parsing created additional cookies from unrecognised `name=value` attributes, and `CookieJar` had no limit on the number of cookies stored or sent. A server could make the client store a very large number of cookies and generate very large `Cookie` headers. A malicious server could cause excessive memory and CPU use in a client, repeated on every redirect, and cause later requests to…

items.title: AIOHTTP: Too many URL-encoded form fields block the event loop

items.snippet: The `max_msg_size` check in the WebSocket reader added the declared frame length to the size of the partial message already buffered. items.title: AIOHTTP: Unbounded buffering of data received during an upgrade request
items.snippet: While a request flagged as an upgrade (e.g. a WebSocket handshake) was being handled, all further data received on the connection was buffered with no size limit or flow control until the handler completed. items.title: AIOHTTP: Pure-Python parser request replay and buffer growth behind a declined upgrade
